name: Sotsugyou Shashin ~Naked Color~
original_name: 卒業写真 ～ネイキッドカラー～
source:
Keisuke is a high school student. He has a girlfriend Kyouko attending the same class. This is the best time of their youth and time to make memories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圭介是一名高中生，女友京子与他同班。此刻正是两人青春中最美好的时光，也是共同留下回忆的时候。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
